explicitNonClaims: An automated metric or carrier roundtrip pass is not a human visibility result.
A developer/owner pilot can validate only the interface and recording workflow.
Even a formal pass applies only to this six-second proxy, tested displays, viewing conditions and observer sample.
The protocol does not validate scene-linear EXR masters, motion blur, 4K cinema projection, another scene or another render engine.
Absence of reported difference is not proof that no difference exists.
The study evaluates temporal stability differences, not acting, composition, narrative quality or overall cinematic merit.
